title: Orb Island
author: Seth Morrow
description: A 3D game made with box3dxt's b3k Kit: one floating island with three levels to climb, the shore, the terraces and the summit, and 26 golden orbs to find without falling into the sea. Climb a stair of slabs, ride lifts, cross a bridge of crumbling and turning planks, dodge flying enemies, find the feather for a double jump, push a crate onto a pressure plate to open a vault, and touch flags to set checkpoints. Keyboard, mouse or gamepad, with sound and a new island tune every time you play. With render3dxt it is lit and glowing, with Kenney's animated hero, forests and models.
